newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank issues 10 bln yen undated loan.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank issues 10 bln yen undated loan.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Swedbank said on Thursday it had issued a 10 billion yen undated subordinated loan in the form a private placement.
Swebank said the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority had given it the right to redeem the loan after 15 years.
U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch International had acted as agent in placing the loan, it said.
"The issue is part of the restructuring of the Sparbanken Sverige (Swedbank) group's subordinated loan capital to longer maturities and a larger share of undated subordinated debt," it said.
